location.title: In the Heart of Dhaka City
location.description: Hotel Shuktara Dhaka occupies a prime location in the vibrant Farmgate area, one of Dhaka's most well-connected and bustling commercial hubs. Situated at H# 20/A, Indira Road, Sher-E-Bangla Nagar, the hotel offers guests easy access to key landmarks, government offices, educational institutions, and major business districts. With close proximity to the Farmgate bus stand and nearby metro stations, getting around the city is effortless. Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, our central location ensures convenience, connectivity, and comfort throughout your stay.
